lessons: A name matched inside a PLACE name is a false positive the escalation gate cannot catch, because the gate only asks whether a watched instrument was named: 'Maybank Highway at Main Road closed after a crash' reached the queue as a Maybank story. Falsifiable: requiring the match to sit beside a company-shaped token (Berhad, Bhd, Group, the ticker) or refusing one followed by a road or place noun would drop this article, leaving two stories for this name rather than three.

A fetch timestamp is not a data date. The price cache recorded fetched_on 2026-09-06 while its newest bar stayed 2026-09-04, so a freshness check written against fetch time would call this cache current.
